BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

2. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.

5. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

9. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.

10. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

12. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.

13. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

14. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

15. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)

   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

16. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Building Material Schedules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
